scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-punch "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.js"
scripts.test:online: vite build --mode emulator --outDir dist-emulator && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-punch "playwright test -c playwright.online.config.js"
scripts.pv: node tools/record-pv.mjs pv-out && ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i pv-out/frames/%05d.jpg -i pv-out/audio.wav -vf "scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos,format=yuv420p" -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -af "loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11" -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart -shortest pv-out/punch_pv.mp4
